frozenDecisions.text: REST control plane stays; no GraphQL.
Telnyx is default carrier; Twilio is failover behind one carrier interface. Amazon Connect stays out of the DID path.

meta.note: SKELETON. Stage 0 commits the shape; requirement IDs and verifier references are populated by the contract owner via approved contract-diff PRs only. Generated types and verifiers are CI-produced, never hand-edited.

requirements.statement: Every REST endpoint verifies the Cognito tenant claim before serving.
Inbound call webhook resolves the tenant from the dialed number.
A VoiceSession is swappable and scorable behind the interface.
Owner copilot tools confirm before any mutation.
Tenant onboarding reaches go-live in under 10 minutes and ends with a demo call to the owner's phone.

qualityRatchet.note: Floors only move UP. Lowering any is a protected-file change requiring owner review.
